data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $48.466 million in 2018, representing 12.84% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years, particularly in the Non-Marine Liability class (affecting 2015 and 2016 years of account), Property D&F, and Specie & Cargo. The strengthening also included recalibration of IBNR reserves. The calendar year results were also impacted by several large natural catastrophe events in 2018, including Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami, and Californian wildfires, which had a total net cost of $21.7 million.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of $48.466m is a gross figure explicitly stated in Note 6 and confirmed in the Active Underwriter's report. The breakdown of this development by LOB sums to $44.7m, leaving $3.8m unallocated. The gross claims development triangle shows a total prior year development of +$80.1m, which differs from the explicitly stated $48.466m. The explicit statement is prioritized as it refers to 'claims reserves established at the prior year end' directly.
